Fund balance roll-forward 5,180,438 + 7,431,158 - 8,348,858 + 626,326 - 707,982 = 4,181,082 reconciles. Ending cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents 4,931,651 (p5); certificates of deposit 344,359 as ending_investments; county treasurer cash 32,010 separate; beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary funds statement Total column (p9): receipts = operating revenues 5,974,621 + interest 16,630 + grant income 324,583; disbursements = operating expenses 5,192,815 + loss on disposal 1,800 + bond issuance costs 28,488 + interest 32,507 (the Statement of Activities total 5,253,810 excludes the loss, which it shows in general revenues); 9,223,524 + 6,315,834 - 5,255,610 + 197,656 = 10,481,404 reconciles. Utility 'Other revenue' is counted in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities (5,974,621). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position, governmental and business-type columns (component unit excluded); totals from the Total column.
